items.text: Today, I tested positive for COVID-19. I am vaccinated and boosted, experiencing mild symptoms, and will quarantine in line with CDC guidance. I am grateful to our health care professionals and researchers who have given us the tools to manage this deadly virus. Get vaccinated!

One of my priorities in Congress is helping families devastated by substance use disorder. I spoke with @wbur about the barriers to receiving treatment & how my student loan repayment program for recovery professionals is helping alleviate this crisis. 🎧 https://t.co/XU2YQfgyqw

No community has been untouched by the opioid epidemic. Saving lives means prioritizing harm reduction & increasing access to treatment, and I'm proud to see my student loan repayment program for the SUD workforce included in @potus' plan to tackle this crisis.

We need answers from Abbott Nutrition about when families can expect to see formula back on shelves. Proud to lead this letter with @RepLoriTrahan & @RepPressley to get families the help they need. https://t.co/3quEVXWf88

PASSED! My Into the Light Act will provide permanent mental health resources to moms, from a 24/7 voice & text hotline to improved screening & treatment. It is our duty to ensure moms have the support they need & I'm thrilled that the House just voted to pass this critical bill.

The @gop doesn’t care about children & their life after birth. If they did, they’d support:

Universal Pre-K
Child care subsidies 
Paid parental leave
Child nutrition programs

Unlike them, @HouseDemocrats are here to protect our children & ensure they thrive into adulthood.

Like I said last night to @AliciaMenendez, the #GOP agenda will not stop at abortion rights - next is IVF treatment, interracial marriage, LGBTQ+ rights & much more. We need a pro-choice majority in the House & Senate to protect freedom and liberty in this country. https://t.co/uW9pWXmwvA

Yesterday, Senate Republicans blocked cancer treatment & health care for vets.

Today, House Republicans are trying to stop the CHIPS bill — aka U.S. jobs & lower costs for families.

For the @GOP, it's never about you. It's always about power.

Democrats put #PeopleOverPolitics.

"It took three days at home until I became sick 'enough' that the ethics board at our hospital agreed we could begin medical treatment; three days until my life was considered at risk 'enough' for the inevitable premature delivery of my daughter to be performed...

Thank you, @RepWexton, for your courage.

In sharing your diagnosis, you've inspired hope for all Americans with Parkinson's.

I'm proud to stand with you in the fight to shine a light on this illness, support those battling it, and find a cure.

145 fewer local law enforcement officers 

4,000 fewer FBI personnel, including those who investigate crimes

60,000 seniors robbed of nutrition services

300,000 households—including 20,000 veterans & 90,000 seniors—without housing vouchers, putting them at risk of homelessness

The state of health care for moms and babies in America is unacceptable. 
 
We can — and we must — ensure all women and their families can access high-quality, life-saving care.
https://t.co/pIqXqW8hcH

Today marks the first anniversary of the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act.

Thanks to this landmark law, new and expecting moms no longer have to choose between their work, their health, and the wellness of their babies.

Now, moms and kids are guaranteed the respect they deserve.

Sending love and strength to @RepRaulGrijalva and his family. 
 
As you undergo treatment, know that your House Democratic family is standing in the fight with you — ready to assist however possible.
https://t.co/4pHKzC6jmL

Because of Texas’ abortion ban, @TheRyanHamilton and his wife were denied miscarriage treatment 3 times.

He later found her lying unconscious — moments away from death — in a pool of her own blood.
 
This is Republican extremism. And they must be stopped.

Senate Republicans just blocked a bill that would guarantee access to IVF and fertility treatment — for the second time. 
 
Don't believe what they say. Believe what they do.

The @HouseGOP has completed its latest exercise in futility.

We are just 12 days away from a shutdown. Let's stop wasting the American people's time and get to work on a clean, short-term spending bill that honors the bipartisan funding agreement.

#ElectionDay is finally here.
 
There is nothing more sacred or foundational to our democracy than making your voice heard at the ballot box.
 
Exercise your right.
 
Play your part in shaping our nation's future.

So the GOP thinks we can afford $45M for a parade to fan Trump's ego but not health care and food for kids?

https://t.co/QoSSGD9fFl

Right now, Veteran Crisis Hotline calls are going unanswered and clinics are operating dangerously understaffed. 

Even cancer patients are struggling to access treatment. 

And what's the GOP's plan for vets? Fire 30,000 VA employees and slash critical VA funding in their Big, Ugly Bill. 

And just like their sweeping cuts at FEMA, the National Weather Service, Social Security, and USAID, these callous choices are going to have terrible consequences.

Thanks to the GOP’s Big, Ugly law, over 300 rural hospitals will close across America.

Patients will be forced to drive hours for emergency care — or be left with no options at all.

They're jeopardizing the health and wellness of millions to pad the pockets of a wealthy few.

60 years ago today, Medicaid and Medicare transformed health care in America.

Today, the GOP is rolling back access to care to pad the pockets of the wealthy few.
 
We won't stand by while they make care less affordable and our families less healthy. You deserve better.

“I don’t want to just survive. Medicaid helps me live a fulfilling, independent life... I should be able to control my own life, just like anyone else.”

Mike relies on Medicaid to live, along with 4.5 million Americans. 

How could the GOP choose billionaire tax cuts over the lives of their own constituents?

https://t.co/mk9BiYG717

Remember when Republicans said they wouldn’t touch Medicaid and Medicare?

Me too. https://t.co/mAyx5Z9wcU

Donald Trump told Americans he would never come after Medicaid. 

Then, he signed a Big Ugly Law that cuts it by over $900B to give tax cuts to billionaires. 

You deserve better than this betrayal. https://t.co/alOzDukApj
